about_the_game:
The Fifth Bell is an atmospheric mystical horror inspired by an old legend. You play as Mark, a folklorist exploring an ancient village shrouded in fog and mystery. Hidden within the village are five mystical offerings that appear in random locations each time you play. Find them and place them on the altar to discover whether the legend is true. But beware—the Reaper never sleeps. With every toll of the bell, he draws closer, hunting you. Game Features: Randomized placement of offerings — each run feels different with new challenges. A relentless Reaper stalks you, keeping the tension and fear alive. A foggy, mystical village with an eerie atmosphere where danger may lurk around every corner. A glowing green stick to help guide your way through the darkness. Survival depends on your focus and speed — every bell toll brings danger closer. Prepare yourself: will you manage to gather all the offerings and survive the fifth bell… or will the Reaper claim you first?

The game does not end with its current version. The story will continue to grow and unfold with new details. In the future, players can expect: New story chapters that reveal the secrets of the curse; Locations with unique atmosphere — abandoned houses, forgotten towns, and places haunted by chilling legends; Improved interaction mechanics and new survival elements; More tense moments and unexpected events. The curse has not vanished — it is only waiting to manifest itself in new places.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: ОС Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (4 GB) / AMD R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for stable performance. For the best experience, use headphones.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: ОС Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: An SSD and headphones are strongly recommended for full immersion.
